/* ConsentMapper.selectActiveTerms */ SELECT B.TERMS_ID AS termsId , S.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS termsNm , B.TERMS_VERSION AS termsVersion , B.TERMS_DESC AS termsDesc FROM TB_TERMS B
LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_SYST_VAL_D S ON ( S.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS008' AND S.SYST_VAL_D_CD = B.TERMS_ID ) WHERE 1=1 AND B.TERMS_ID = #{termsId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1

/* ConsentMapper.countActiveSiteLinkMember */ SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_SITE_LINK L WHERE L.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ( (L.SRC_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND L.SRC_SITE_CD = #{siteCd}) OR (L.DST_CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND L.DST_SITE_CD = #{siteCd}) )

/* ConsentMapper.selectOptionalTerms */ SELECT B.TERMS_ID AS termsId , S.SYST_VAL_D_NM AS termsNm , B.TERMS_VERSION AS termsVersion , B.TERMS_CONTENT AS termsContent , CASE WHEN A.AGR_YN = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS agrYn FROM TB_TERMS B INNER JOIN TB_SYST_VAL_D S ON ( S.SYST_VAL_CD = 'SYS008' AND S.SYST_VAL_D_CD = B.TERMS_ID ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_TERMS_USER_AGR_MGMT A ON ( A.TERMS_ID = B.TERMS_ID AND A.TERMS_VERSION = B.TERMS_VERSION AND A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} ) WHERE 1=1 AND B.REQUIRED_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y'
/* ConsentMapper.selectOptionalTermsCurrentVersion */ SELECT B.TERMS_VERSION FROM TB_TERMS B WHERE B.TERMS_ID = #{termsId} AND B.REQUIRED_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1
